what: Each stacked hero photo carries a handwritten line that is drawn one stroke at a time at 200px per second. Once fully drawn it holds for 2.2s, then crossfades into the next photo over 1.8s power2.out — the next photo’s line enters erased and is drawn again (endlessly). A photo with no line holds for 1.8s

options.fade: Overlap length when switching with the next section (s), default 1.8
options.ease: Transition curve — GSAP name or ”0.215,0.61,0.355,1”, default power2.out
options.on: If manual, it starts when fx:play is sent (after the loader clears)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: SVG paths to be drawn within the section — in the order listed

note: Line color is currentColor — set text color over photos with color on the section or svg

from.where: index.js .t-hero (original top-hero__kv — three photos, a handwritten .draw-path per section, starts after the first-visit intro lifts and body.loaded is attached)
